quality_guards: Agricultural-machinery risk depends on machine type, guards, task, operator competence, maintenance, terrain, weather and isolation practice.
HSE agricultural-machinery evidence is machine-, task-, operator-, farm-, control- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level injury probability.
Compressed-air risk depends on pressure, plant condition, contamination, task, containment, decompression profile, medical fitness and emergency readiness.
HSE compressed-air evidence is plant-, pressure-, worker-, procedure-, environment- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level injury probability.
Ionising-radiation risk depends on source type, activity, energy, distance, shielding, duration, work practice, monitoring and individual dose history.
HSE ionising-radiation evidence is source-, practice-, workplace-, worker-, control- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level health probability.
Non-ionising-radiation risk depends on frequency, intensity, distance, duration, equipment, shielding, worker susceptibility and implanted devices.
HSE non-ionising-radiation evidence is source-, frequency-, equipment-, worker-, control- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level health probability.
Norovirus risk depends on setting, contact intensity, hygiene, surface contamination, food handling, genotype, host vulnerability and timing.
UKHSA norovirus evidence is outbreak-, setting-, person-, surface-, surveillance- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level infection probability.
Mpox risk depends on viral clade, type and duration of contact, bodily-fluid exposure, setting, symptoms, immunity, vaccination and timing.
UKHSA mpox evidence is case-, contact-, clade-, setting-, vaccine- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level infection probability.
Tuberculosis risk depends on infectiousness, duration and setting of exposure, ventilation, organism, immunity, screening, treatment and adherence.
UKHSA tuberculosis evidence is case-, contact-, setting-, screening-, treatment- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level infection probability.
Baby self-feeding risk depends on product design, feed flow, infant age and ability, position, supervision, use duration and response time.
OPSS self-feeding-product evidence is product-, infant-, use-, exposure-, clinical- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level injury probability.
Cabin-evacuation risk depends on aircraft layout, emergency type, exit availability, smoke, passenger behaviour, baggage, crew coordination and equipment serviceability.
CAA evacuation evidence is aircraft-, cabin-, passenger-, crew-, emergency- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level casualty probability.
Dangerous-goods rail risk depends on substance class, quantity, packaging, wagon condition, routing, handling, train operation, emergency response and reporting.
ORR dangerous-goods evidence is consignment-, wagon-, route-, operator-, incident- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level release probability.
